what: Cruz Missile contacts a compliant W-beam at low, autopilot and boost entry speeds, from glancing to head-on. Every row must actually move a rail, retain all health and parts, cause no wreck or recovery, and replay exactly. Entry speeds are samples, not gameplay limits.
knownGaps: Corner assistance is asserted by a separate differential fixture.
This sweep samples one car model on flat terrain; other roster vehicles and banked terrain require separate rows.
